items.title: We’re introducing SynthID Bio, bringing our watermarking technology to synthetic biology.
items.content: Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio to watermark AI-designed proteins while maintaining biological function. Read the full research report here.
items.contentSnippet: Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio to watermark AI-designed proteins while maintaining biological function. Read the full research report here.

summaries.zh: 谷歌DeepMind推出SynthID Bio技术，将水印技术应用于合成生物学，旨在为AI设计的蛋白质添加可识别的水印，同时保持其生物功能。该技术有助于追踪和验证AI生成的生物成分。详细研究报告请参阅原文链接。
summaries.en: Google DeepMind introduces SynthID Bio, a technology that applies watermarking to synthetic biology. The system embeds detectable markers into AI-designed proteins, enabling their identification while preserving biological functionality. The research aims to enhance transparency and traceability in synthetic biology. For further details, refer to the full report.

items.summary: 谷歌DeepMind推出SynthID Bio技术，将水印技术应用于合成生物学，旨在为AI设计的蛋白质添加可识别的水印，同时保持其生物功能。该技术有助于追踪和验证AI生成的生物成分。详细研究报告请参阅原文链接。

items.content: Explore art and culture with visual-first conversation search, a redesigned home feed, AI experiments and 27 new city guides in the Google Arts & Culture app.
